query:
SELECT 
  p.id as packageId,
  p.totalHours,
  p.usedHours,
  p.isActive,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendances WHERE packageId = p.id) as attendanceCount,
  (SELECT SUM(durationMinutes) FROM attendances WHERE packageId = p.id) as totalDuration
FROM packages p 
WHERE p.residentId = 1 
ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  id,
  checkInTime,
  checkOutTime,
  durationMinutes,
  packageId
FROM attendances 
WHERE residentId = 1 
ORDER BY checkInTime ASC;
